spans.s:
कोक कोक, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic word),
a wolf; a cuckoo; the ruddy goose; a frog; a small
lizard or chameleon; a kind of noxious parasitical
animal; the wild date tree; an epithet of Viṣṇu;
N. of a man, a son of Śoṇa; N. of a river.
—कोक-
देव, अस्, m. a pigeon.
—कोक-नख, आस्, m. pl.,
N. of a people.
—कोक-बन्धु, उस्, m. the friend
of the Cakravāka or ruddy goose, an epithet of the
sun.
—कोक-यातु, उस्, m., Ved. a demon or ghost
in the shape of a cuckoo.
—कोक-वाच, अस्, m. a sort
of animal living in caves, a fox (?).
—कोक-शास्त्र,
अम्, n., N. of a very indecent treatise on the art of
love, ascribed to a Paṇḍit named Koka.
—कोकाग्र
(˚क-अग्˚), अस्, m., N. of a plant, = समष्ठिल.

कोकड कोकड, अस्, m. an animal of a brown
colour, with a bushy tail, lurking in holes, perhaps a
hare or fox.

कोकनद कोकनद, आस्, m. pl., N. of a
people; (अम्), n. the red lotus; the red water-lily.
—कोकनद-च्छवि, इस्, m. the colour of the red
lotus; (इस्, इस्, इ), of the colour of the red lotus.
कोकरक कोकरक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
कोकलिक कोकलिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
कोकली कोकली, f., N. of a woman.

कोकामुख कोकामुख, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?),
N. of a Tīrtha.

कोकाह कोकाह, अस्, m. a white horse; (per-
haps a foreign word.)

कोकिल कोकिल, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic
word; but by some said to be fr. rt. कुक्), the
Kokila or Koïl, the black or Indian cuckoo, Cuculus
Indicus; a kind of mouse; a kind of poisonous insect;
a firebrand, a lighted coal; N. of a poet; N. of a
Rājaputra; (आ), f. the female of a Kokila, (the Kokila
or Koïl is frequently alluded to in Hindū poetry, and
its musical cry is supposed to inspire pleasing and
tender emotions.)
—कोकिल-नयन, अस्, m. a plant
bearing a dark black flower, Capparis Spinosa; it is
also applied to Barleria Longifolia; [cf. कोकिलाक्ष.]
—कोकिल-मैत्रावरुण, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to
the duties or office of the Maitrāvaruṇa priest at the
Kaukilīṣṭi; (अम्), n. title of a treatise.
—कोकिल-
होत्र, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the duties or office of
the Hotṛ priest at the Kaukilīṣṭi; (अम्), n. title of
a treatise.
—कोकिलाक्ष (˚ल-अक्˚), अस्, m. ‘having
eyes like those of the Koïl,’ the plant Asteracantha
Longifolia or Capparis Spinosa.
—कोकिलाक्षक, अस्,
m. the same plant.
—कोकिला-माहात्म्य, अम्, n. title
of a part of the Skanda-purāṇa.
—कोकिलावास (˚ल-
आव्˚), अस्, m. the Mango tree; [cf. आम्र.]
—कोकि-
लेक्षु (˚ल-इक्˚), उस्, m. the black variety of sugar-
cane; [cf. कृष्णेक्षु.]
—कोकिलेष्टा (˚ल-इष्˚),
f., N. of a plant, = महा-जम्बू.
—कोकिलोत्सव
(˚ल-उत्˚), अस्, m. the Mango tree.

कोकिलक, अस् or अम्, m. or n (?), N. of a metre
of four lines, each containing seventeen syllables.

कोक्क्वोक कोक्क्वोक, अस्, m., N. of the author
of the Rati-rahasya.
